hardRules: Do not deploy to Railway until operator explicitly allows it.
Do not run Postgres replay until storage is upgraded.
Do not place live trading orders.
Humans only approve, sign, and commit.

policies.rule: Nexora is the only decision authority. Workers execute delegated work only.
Trading and Phantom X remain paper/sandbox unless explicitly promoted through approval.
Purchase orders and supplier commitments require approval.
Customer-facing binding quotes require approval.
If Postgres is unavailable or full, capture work in local fallback systems.
